Center for Educational Initiatives: Sustainable and equitable access to quality education:project-based 'catch-up' learning in rural schools

description.narrative: The project' Sustainable and equitable access to quality education: project-based 'catch-up' learning in rural schools' is implemented by the Centre for Education Initiatives in 20 rural communities in Ukraine. From April 2023 to March 2025, 80 teachers will learn how to provide learning-by-doing project-based education to develop their students' key competences and implement the New Ukrainian School fundamentals. 300 education projects realised during the school year and school-based summer camps will provide needs-based offline 'catch-up' education for school students (grades 1 to 6). 40 education project scenarios will be tested and made available to all the teachers in Ukraine.
